plugins.rationale: Fifty OpenAI-authored life-science skills complement Evidence Lab protocol and bias checks without duplicating their boundary.

required_before_default: Run representative genetics, protein, and clinical retrieval tasks
Review provenance and failure behavior with an independent life-science reviewer

plugins.rationale: The bundle is valuable for explicit sequencing workflows but its heavy local toolchain and mixed maturity make a broad life-science default unsafe.

required_before_default: Add an onboarding signal for sequencing and omics work
Pass isolated tests for every execution lane and dependency preflight

plugins.rationale: Zotero adds local library operations while Evidence Lab retains portable citation validation; it is useful only when Zotero Desktop is present or requested.

required_before_default: Detect Zotero Desktop without changing local settings
Test read, export, and approved import against an isolated library

plugins.rationale: The bundle covers interactive and browser-native visualization while Evidence Lab scientific visualization remains focused on publication figures.

required_before_default: Add an onboarding choice for interactive outputs
Benchmark accessibility, source traceability, and export behavior

plugins.rationale: The hybrid contains useful skills but also twenty app dependencies, so it cannot be presented as a zero-setup replacement for portable data analysis.

required_before_default: Map every required app and connection interstitial
Benchmark overlap and failure modes against Evidence Lab structured-data analysis

plugins.rationale: Wolfram is a strong quantitative companion, but it is an external app connection rather than a bundled Evidence Lab skill and requires separate consent.

required_before_default: Test the Codex connection and disconnect flow
Benchmark equations, units, provenance, and graceful failure on representative tasks

plugins.rationale: BioRender can complement image analysis with scientific illustration, but it is a separately connected service and must not be silently installed.

required_before_default: Test consent, account requirements, and export ownership
Benchmark diagram accuracy and editable output on representative life-science tasks
